name: Yui Akiyama
source:
Yui is a super-shy girl, perhaps even more closed off than any of the other girls. She's a big fan of horror novels and you often wonder what's going on in that head of hers.

You might have a hard time winning her affection, simply because she is not used  to opening up to anyone.
